nodes.label: Multi-Expert Feature
nodes.rationale: Creator mengundang pakar; setiap pakar menilai secara independen, allowing independent multi-expert judgment collection before aggregation.

nodes.label: Automatic Aggregation (Geometric Mean / AIJ)
nodes.rationale: Aggregasi otomatis antar pakar menggunakan geometric mean (Aggregation of Individual Judgments) untuk menggabungkan penilaian multi-pakar.

nodes.label: Consistency Ratio (CR)
nodes.rationale: Dihitung otomatis per pakar per level untuk memvalidasi konsistensi penilaian pairwise comparison.

nodes.label: src/components/TrueFocus.jsx (Animated Text Focus)
nodes.rationale: TrueFocus applies a per-word blur-to-focus animation with an animated corner-bracket frame highlighting the active word, used as a stylistic emphasis effect for headline text.
